Reports.Name: BeamStatusReport
Reports.Reasoning: Groups beam current, energy level, dose amount and vacuum/scan position to give full beam status beyond BeamStable event

Reports.Name: ScanStartReport
Reports.Reasoning: Combines wafer ID, target dose, scan count and current beam current to provide context for ScanStarted

Reports.Name: ScanCompleteReport
Reports.Reasoning: Enriches ScanCompleted with wafer ID, delivered dose, scan count and final scan position

Reports.Name: VacuumReadyReport
Reports.Reasoning: Adds beam current and energy level to vacuum level for a broader view of equipment readiness
